# RC37 — Local references fallback

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- `Esc c r` still uses semantic LSP references when the active buffer has a ready synchronized server.
- If no ready server exists, `Esc c r` now extracts the identifier under the cursor and opens a searchable `LOCAL REFERENCES` picker.
- The local fallback scans exact identifier-boundary occurrences, so `bird` does not match `birdhouse`.
- Local reference jumps open the target file, move the cursor to the occurrence, and record jump history.
- The scan is bounded and root-identity checked:
  - first 2,000 indexed files
  - 1 MiB per file
  - 1,000 retained references
  - recognized indexed source files only
  - workspace-root identity validation before and after the scan
